title: moduleDefinition
responsibility: Validate declarative module definitions and persisted installation and resource records.

outputs.name: moduleFileSchema
outputs.description: A strict Zod schema for a module file with exactly a trimmed, non-empty path and string contents. Unknown fields are rejected, and contents may be empty.

outputs.name: moduleResourceSchema
outputs.description: A strict schema for a resource object with slug-form id and kind, trimmed non-empty title and singular, at least one trimmed non-empty instruction, optional catalog limited to apis, permissions, module-library, layouts, components, models, services, functions, types, configs, styles, or dependencies, and optional boolean primary. Exactly one of non-empty files (strict file objects with trimmed non-empty path and string contents; omitted files defaults to []) or generator is accepted; generator is either scaffold with scaffold equal to model or a scaffoldKinds value and optional level molecule or organism, or dependency alone; unknown fields are rejected and the other optional fields have no defaults.

outputs.name: moduleDefinitionSchema
outputs.description: A strict schema for a module definition with schemaVersion 1, a slug id, a version made of exactly three numeric components, trimmed non-empty title and description, at least one trimmed non-empty instruction, setup file objects with trimmed non-empty paths and string contents, a dependencies record, and at least one resource. Optional appOnly and includedByDefault are booleans, visibility is internal or plugin, testing is a strict object with headless true and a trimmed non-empty script, order is an integer from 0 through 10000, and packageScripts and devDependencies are records; these optional fields have no defaults, record values are trimmed non-empty strings, resource ids must be unique, and unknown fields are rejected.

outputs.name: moduleStateSchema
outputs.description: A strict schema for persisted module state with schemaVersion 1, modules pairing a module definition with source builtin or project, and resource entries containing slug-form module and type ids, a trimmed non-empty name, and at least one trimmed non-empty file path. Both arrays may be empty, entries and top-level state reject unknown fields.

outputs.name: moduleStateFile
outputs.description: The fixed filename used for persisted module state. Its value is harness.modules.json.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown by a caller's .parse() when a module file, resource, definition, or state value fails validation, including strict-object checks and the custom resource-file/generator exclusivity or duplicate-resource-id checks. This module exports the schemas but does not itself call .parse().
